decision_rule: Block by detected semantic/provenance/challenger/replay/static-report evidence, not by task id alone.

gates.G2: Detect legal-field semantic answer encoding, not only forbidden-name matches.
gates.G3: Detect when a simple legal baseline equals oracle.
gates.G4: Detect evaluator privilege where oracle/scorer has rule access not granted to baselines.
gates.G5: Detect missing fair challengers by synthesizing simple legal baselines.
gates.G8: Detect same-state proxy leaks through metadata/context/action-index fields.
gates.G9: Refuse static pass reports and non-fail-able boolean claims.
